title: What the DOM represents
learningObjectives: Explain what the dom represents and read or transform JavaScript data safely.

understand.concept: The Document Object Model represents an HTML document as a tree of nodes and objects. JavaScript can use DOM APIs to find, read, create, update, and remove elements. The DOM is a programming interface for the document, not the original HTML source text.
understand.whyItMatters: Understanding the DOM explains how scripts update a page after it loads. Safe DOM methods help keep content separate from executable markup.
understand.analogy: The DOM is like a live tree representation of the page: each element is a node connected to its parent and children.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; JavaScript references, serialization, and DOM APIs have precise behaviour defined by the language and web platform.
